message: My dinner set (ORD-1060) still hasn't arrived and it's been more than three weeks.

evidence.sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, delivery_date, product_name, category, unit_price, quantity, order_total, payment_method, status, final_sale FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.orders WHERE customer_id = 'C009' AND order_id = 'ORD-1060'
SELECT refund_id, customer_id, order_id, request_date, amount, reason, decision FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.refund_history WHERE customer_id = 'C009'
SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.refund_policy WHERE category = 'Home' OR category = 'ALL'

rows.rule_text: Unused items may be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
Items that arrive damaged or defective are refunded in full within 30 days of delivery; a photo is requested.
If an order has not been delivered 14 days after the order date, the customer may choose a refund or a replacement.
Items marked final sale cannot be refunded unless they are defective.
Any refund above 200.00 must be reviewed by a support lead before approval.
Customers with 3 or more refunds in the last 90 days are sent to human review to check for abuse.
An order can be refunded only once. Requests for an order that was already refunded are rejected.
When the customer's claim conflicts with order or carrier records, the case goes to human review.

proposed_decision.rationale: Order ORD-1060 was placed on 2026-10-01 and has not been delivered after 24 days, exceeding R4's 14-day not_received threshold (E1). The order total is $95.00, under the $200.00 auto-approve limit; final_sale is false, already_refunded is false, and approved_refunds_last_90_days is 0 (E1, E2). No conflicting rule applies (E3).

critique.reason: Every factual claim in the proposal is supported by an evidence id and matches the Python checks: E1 confirms order date 2026-10-01, delivery_date null, status shipped, order_total $95.00, final_sale false; E2's empty refund history confirms already_refunded false and 0 approved refunds in the last 90 days; E3 contains R4 (14-day not_received threshold, $200.00 auto-approve limit, outcome approve) and no blocking rule (R5, R7, R8, R9, R10) applies given final_sale=false, total under limit, zero prior refunds, and no record conflict. The 24 days since order exceeds the 14-day threshold.

customer_reply: I'm sorry your Ceramic Dinner Set hasn't arrived yet. Since it's been 24 days since your order on October 1st, you can choose a full refund or a replacement. Please let me know which you prefer.
limitations: No delivery tracking carrier details beyond order status were available for verification.
